$description: Canadian payroll contribution rates and maximums for 2026: CPP/CPP2, QPP/QPP2, EI (federal and Quebec), and QPIP. Rates are decimals.

cpp.name: Canada Pension Plan (base + first additional)
cpp.note: YMPE (Year's Maximum Pensionable Earnings) rose from $71,300 in 2025 to $74,600 in 2026.

cpp2.name: CPP second additional contribution (CPP2)
cpp2.note: Applies to pensionable earnings between the YMPE and the YAMPE (Year's Additional Maximum Pensionable Earnings, $85,000 in 2026, up from $81,200 in 2025).

qpp.name: Quebec Pension Plan (base + first additional)
qpp.note: Quebec reduced the QPP first-tier rate to 6.30% for 2026 (it was 6.40% in 2025). QPP2 mirrors CPP2 at 4% on the YMPE-YAMPE band.

ei.name: Employment Insurance

quebec.note: Quebec workers pay a reduced EI rate because parental benefits are provided through QPIP instead.

ei.note: Maximum insurable earnings rose from $65,700 in 2025 to $68,900 in 2026; the employee rate is $1.63 per $100 of insurable earnings.

qpip.name: Quebec Parental Insurance Plan
qpip.note: QPIP premium rates fell for 2026 (employee rate from 0.494% to 0.430%) while the insurable earnings maximum rose to $103,000.
